title: Cozy Cole, Philly Joe Jones and Max Roach
summary: Jones credits Cozy Cole as a teacher and speaks of Philly Joe and Max Roach, whom he knew when young.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: We've mentioned Cozy but not justifiably because he's one of the truly great -
Sure, he's done so much because when he had his two schools, he had the one by himself and then he had the one with Krupa. He's a wonderful instructor.
Cozy Cole and Gene Krupa had a school.
Yes, of course. A lot of guys owe Cozy a lot. You take the Philly Joes, you take Max - I couldn't be here, and Kenny Clarke is gone.
Philly Joe Jones and then Max Roach, who's a master

No, I would say, Milt, and I haven't seen him in nearly a year. Knowing him as I know him from 16, and I knew Max at 14 and Miles at 12 - but I don't believe, because he didn't stop... which people don't know... after Shadow Wilson naturally... Philly Joe, Rudolf is quite a musician and I don't know of nobody that can play like him, nobody.
Max Roach, Professor Max Roach. Well, 22 years ago he told me it couldn't be done. Now he's writing for voices and he's a professor now.
... I'll think in this period we'll try to mention some of your friends that you know.
